description: Aggregated land and property price reference for the area around a parcel. Never returns individual sales. Price figures exist only in France (DVF recorded sales: average EUR/m2, number of sales, last sale date, estimated value), Italy (OMI zone values from Agenzia delle Entrate) and Germany (official Bodenrichtwert land value per m2, North Rhine-Westphalia only; elsewhere in Germany it answers available=false). For Spain (ES, PV, NA) and Portugal it returns a reference note without figures: there is no per-parcel price source yet. One API call.

country.description: Optional country code: ES, PV, NA, PT, FR, IT or DE. Omit to auto-detect.
